title: description lacks useful semantic information

heuristics: too short to describe a capability
no concrete capability or task keywords

message: The description is too thin or too generic for an agent to decide when this skill applies; it should state concrete capabilities and include the keywords users would actually invoke.

title: description lacks activation/use-case boundary

heuristics: states what the skill does but not when to use it
no trigger phrasing or use-case keywords

message: The description explains what the skill does but not when it should activate; the specification expects a description to cover both what the skill does and when to use it.

title: sibling Skill descriptions overlap excessively

heuristics: high lexical overlap between sibling descriptions in the same pack
same trigger keywords with no differentiation

message: Two or more sibling skills in the same pack have heavily overlapping descriptions, which makes trigger selection ambiguous; differentiate when each skill should activate.
